purpose: Define the core logic, data structures, anomaly detection rules, and pattern analysis engines that govern real-time telemetry operations within Beast System 3.0.

data_streams.description: Primary telemetry streams monitored and processed by the engine.

core_functions.description: Primary computational functions of the telemetry engine.

functions.name: Real-Time Anomaly Detection
functions.logic: Compare incoming metrics against baseline models and threshold rules.

functions.name: Pattern-of-Practice Analysis
functions.logic: Identify repeated harmful, biased, or irregular municipal behavior.

functions.name: Rights-Impact Scoring
functions.logic: Compute risk scores for retaliation, discrimination, or trauma escalation.

functions.name: Predictive Risk Modeling
functions.logic: Forecast system failures, resource shortages, or civilian harm risks.

anomaly_detection_rules.description: Rules governing anomaly classification and escalation.

pattern_analysis_engines.description: Engines responsible for long-term pattern detection and systemic risk identification.

engines.name: Bias Pattern Engine
engines.logic: Detects discriminatory enforcement or resource allocation patterns.

engines.name: Corruption Signature Engine
engines.logic: Identifies relational anomalies, favoritism, or irregular access patterns.

engines.name: Systemic Failure Engine
engines.logic: Detects cascading infrastructure or operational risks.

kernel_dependencies.identity_kernel: Required for actor verification, timestamp authority, and access mapping.
kernel_dependencies.telemetry_kernel: Primary engine for anomaly detection, pattern analysis, and risk scoring.
kernel_dependencies.ethics_kernel: Required for rights-impact evaluation and constitutional safeguards.
